status: Exploratory extension frozen after baseline pilot; not a registered paper result.
scope: clarify the mechanism of same-model cache agreement across changed preceding contexts
selection: two short and two long archive handoffs, hash-ranked, unique trajectories; longest eligible matched block; errors not consulted
prediction: preserving more of the immediate prefix should reduce same-block cache deviation; this is tested, not assumed
normalization: per-layer/head variance of the fixed fresh reference block; same normalizer within each paired comparison
limits: short snippets, four trace cases, source-size model; does not establish long-context or generation-quality claims
contrast: Preserve equal numbers of original prefix tokens at the beginning versus the end of the 512-token prefix; replace all remaining positions with different token IDs.
